Fleetwood Mac's "The Chain" was first used for Formula 1 in 1978, when the BBC adopted it as the title music for their F1 coverage [d7][d8]. Multiple sources confirm this, with d8 stating explicitly that "the song was first adopted by the BBC on its F1 coverage back in 1978," and d9 noting it was used "from 1978–1996, then again from 2009–2015" [d9][d5]. The BBC continued using it until 1996, after which ITV took over F1 broadcasting rights and chose different music [d4]. When the BBC returned to F1 coverage in 2009, "The Chain" returned with them, and Channel 4 subsequently continued using it from 2016 [d7][d4].
